caveat: FP32 on CPU through onnxruntime at batch 1; not INT8 and not the Jetson Orin Nano Super. The ~30 ms TARGET on slide 3 (YOLO11-s INT8 inference at 640 px on that board, hardware this project does not own) is a design budget, not a measurement, and is not comparable to any number in this file. pipeline_ms covers the detector stage only (letterbox, inference, decode, class-aware NMS in numpy) and is not end-to-end. Latency follows the graph and the host, not the weights, except that NMS cost grows with the number of candidate boxes; see pipeline_detail.
